=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/gh_call_counter/gh, scripts/gh_call_counter/gh-call-counter-summary:(new files, no line; tests/test_gh_call_counter.py lines 19-21) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The PR diff adds both canonical counter files (mode 100755), but they are reported missing from the PR checkout, even though the tests, the agents.d fragment and the README all name them.
  WHY: Every test that reads them fails (SHIM.read_text(), SUMMARY.read_text(), shutil.copyfile in _counter_dir(), _run([str(SUMMARY)])), which matches the pre-push gate's failure list; both reviewers rated this BLOCKER. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputes it: both files exist on the PR head, head check-runs show failed_count: 0, and the gate report looks stale.
- scripts/gh_call_counter/gh:51-55 (with .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5792-5825, .github/workflows/clarify.yml:2777, .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:924) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The shim classifies every non-empty GH_TOKEN as `pat`, so steps that set `GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}` are logged as token=pat, and none of them set the GH_CALL_COUNTER_TOKEN_KIND override.
  WHY: The PAT-free validate job (up to ~60 CI-gate polls), clarify's requeue calls and the sweep's re-run step all show up as calls_by_token=pat, which corrupts the "Top consumers by calls_in_job" ranking (collect_workflow_logs.py call_entry[2] += by_token.get("pat", 0)); all reviewers rated it MAJOR. Fix: add `GH_CALL_COUNTER_TOKEN_KIND: github_token` to each affected step.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:2156-2158 (PAT_BUDGET_WORKFLOWS lines 104-118) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The comment "query only the nine instrumented workflow paths" is stale now that PAT_BUDGET_WORKFLOWS has 10 entries ("test-and-mark-stable.yml" at line 115).
  WHY: No runtime effect, but it misstates how many listings the loop issues per window, the count behind the API-usage and listing-ceiling reasoning; all reviewers rated it NIT.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, clarify.yml, orchestrate_poll.yml, review_autofix_sweep.yml, workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml, validation-improvements-intake.yml:(all end-step `counter_keys="$(gh-call-counter-summary 2>/dev/null || printf ...)"` assignments) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The inline end steps do not handle malformed gh-call-counter-summary output.
  WHY: Malformed output would fail the PAT_BUDGET_LINE regex in scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py and silently drop the end line and the used_in_job metric (rated MAJOR). z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same concern only as a hardening suggestion (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE 1).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Every job that already prints GH_PAT_BUDGET, plus the release-gate jobs, also prints how many gh invocations it made itself"; "Install the shim in the release-gate jobs too (test-and-mark-stable.yml e2e and validate jobs)"
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml jobs workflow-log-analysis-test (line 3880, GH_TOKEN at 3913), orphan-workflows-test (4049/4073), orchestrate-decompose-test (4383/4389), clarify-rejects-unsolvable-test (4971/4977)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: "Install gh call counter" appears only at lines 707, 4853, 5307 and 5731 (e2e-smoke-test, validate-standalone-test, e2e-alt-model-test, validate), the PAT-holding gate jobs listed above have no install step and no start/end budget steps yet run dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh (3991, 4159, 4239, 4319, 4469) and stable_orchestrate_cancel_dispatched_run.sh (4685-4686), GH_CALL_COUNTER_TRUSTED_HELPERS in tests/test_review_autofix_sweep_zero_candidate_fast_exit.py lists only the four instrumented jobs, and the jobs are gated by validate at line 5684 (openai_gpt-6-luna named only three of the four jobs; sonnet and glm call the "e2e" scope a judgement call)
- requirement: "Call the installer at the start of each instrumented job, next to the existing start-phase step" / "For every invocation" the shim records a call
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml, job `poll` install step (line 281)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The start step calls gh api rate_limit at line 149 (gh api calls at lines 140-156) and the promote-candidate resolver calls gh_api_retry at line 179, both before the install at line 281, and scripts/gh_helpers.sh lines 1145-1147 then initialise the log, so these calls are missing from calls_in_job. The same pattern applies to e2e-smoke-test (start read at test-and-mark-stable.yml:666 vs install at 707). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly judged this not a gap, because agents.d documents "calls before the install step" as a known limitation.
- requirement: the acceptance gate "test | tests/test_gh_call_counter.py" must pass (parity, executable, counting, passthrough and token-classification tests)
  expected_change_site: scripts/gh_call_counter/gh and scripts/gh_call_counter/gh-call-counter-summary (plus their embedded copies in scripts/gh_helpers.sh, and tests/test_gh_call_counter.py)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: Neither file is in the PR checkout, the pre-push gate lists 10 failures in tests/test_gh_call_counter.py caused by this change, and the acceptance table marks the test target unmet. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash notes that the files exist on the current head and the gate report appears stale.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/gh_call_counter/gh and scripts/gh_call_counter/gh-call-counter-summary (tests/test_gh_call_counter.py lines 19-21) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Both files are added as new (mode 100755) but are absent from the checkout. The glob finds nothing, and the header "gh call counter shim (issue #9887)" matches only scripts/gh_helpers.sh.
  WHY: SHIM.read_text(), SUMMARY.read_text(), shutil.copyfile in _counter_dir() and _run([str(SUMMARY)]) all fail, which matches the pre-push gate's failure list. Fix: commit both files with mode 0755, byte-identical to the heredocs in scripts/gh_helpers.sh.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5792-5825 (GH_TOKEN at 5794; "no GH_PAT" comment at 5709) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The validate job's "Verify CI passed on source branch" step sets GH_TOKEN to github.token, so the shim records every release_ci_gate.sh call as token=pat.
  WHY: The end line prints calls_by_token=pat:<N> (up to ~60 polls), and collect_workflow_logs.py adds these to the PAT column of the ranking. Fix: add GH_CALL_COUNTER_TOKEN_KIND: github_token.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:2156-2158 (PAT_BUDGET_WORKFLOWS lines 104-116, line 115) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The comment "query only the nine instrumented workflow paths" is stale; there are now 10 entries.
  WHY: The comment misstates the per-window listing count. Fix: say "ten" or drop the count.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  Requirement: "Every job that already prints GH_PAT_BUDGET, plus the release-gate jobs, also prints how many gh invocations it made itself"; polling loops at "scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:257,347" and "scripts/stable_orchestrate_cancel_dispatched_run.sh:51,68"; install the shim "in the release-gate jobs too (test-and-mark-stable.yml e2e and validate jobs)".
  Expected change site: test-and-mark-stable.yml workflow-log-analysis-test (line 3880; dispatch_and_watch at 3991), orphan-workflows-test (line 4049; 4159, 4239, 4319), orchestrate-decompose-test (line 4383; 4469, cancel script at 4685-4686), clarify-rejects-unsolvable-test (line 4971).
  Evidence of absence: "Install gh call counter" appears only at lines 707, 4853, 5307 and 5731, and GH_CALL_COUNTER_TRUSTED_HELPERS lists only those four jobs. Whether these count as "e2e" jobs is a judgement call.
- TASK_GAP | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  Requirement: the acceptance gate "test | tests/test_gh_call_counter.py" must pass.
  Expected change site: scripts/gh_call_counter/gh and scripts/gh_call_counter/gh-call-counter-summary
  Evidence of absence: Neither file exists in the checkout; this root cause explains all 10 listed failures.
- Not reported: orchestrate_poll install after the start step (line 140) and gh_api_retry (line 179), because agents.d documents it as a known gap; the 480,000-byte size guard could not be measured.
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml validate "Verify CI passed on source branch" env (line 5794): add "GH_CALL_COUNTER_TOKEN_KIND: github_token" (1 line).
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml e2e-alt-model-test: the comment "# Required for the run-soft-error-analyzer composite action below." now sits above "Record GH_PAT budget at e2e-alt-model-test start"; move it above "Checkout repository (for soft-error analyser)" (2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/gh_call_counter/gh and scripts/gh_call_counter/gh-call-counter-summary (new files introduced in PR) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Two new canonical executable files are absent from the PR checkout (filed under SECURITY & INPUT VALIDATION).
  WHY: tests/test_gh_call_counter.py and dependent CI fail with FileNotFoundError, which blocks deployment of the counter shim.
- scripts/gh_call_counter/gh:51-55 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The shim attributes github.token usage as `pat` whenever GH_TOKEN is defined.
  WHY: Steps that set `GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}` (e.g. the validate job) skew the "Top consumers by calls_in_job" ranking and the per-token breakdown.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:111-118 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The comment "query only the nine instrumented workflow paths" is wrong now that test-and-mark-stable.yml makes ten.
  WHY: No runtime failure, but it misleads developers.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, clarify.yml, orchestrate_poll.yml, review_autofix_sweep.yml, workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml, validation-improvements-intake.yml (all end-step `counter_keys="$(gh-call-counter-summary 2>/dev/null || printf ...)"` assignments) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: There is no error handling for malformed counter summary output.
  WHY: Malformed output fails the PAT_BUDGET_LINE regex in scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py, and the end line and the used_in_job metric are silently lost.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: "Every job that already prints GH_PAT_BUDGET, plus the release-gate jobs, also prints how many gh invocations it made itself"; "Install the shim in the release-gate jobs too (test-and-mark-stable.yml e2e and validate jobs)"
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml jobs workflow-log-analysis-test, orphan-workflows-test, orchestrate-decompose-test, clarify-rejects-unsolvable-test
  Evidence of absence: No install or start/end budget steps were added; these jobs run dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh and stable_orchestrate_cancel_dispatched_run.sh without instrumentation.
